parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of wood and forming the outer shell.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability for the entire cabinet, holding the shelves and doors in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the cabinet used for placing items.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored objects and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or sometimes adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle wooden shelf inside the cabinet used for organizing items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing objects and helps distribute weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during regular operation.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A wooden shelf located in the upper-middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed within the cabinet and separates storage levels.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A top wooden shelf inside the cabinet for storing lightweight items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an upper storage surface and helps organize the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden door attached to the front of the cabinet, used to open and close the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The second wooden door of the cabinet, forming the other half of the front closure.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and secures the contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It swings open and closed on hinges.
